function m(x: number, y: number | void) { console.log(x, y); }
m();
function n(x: number | void, y: number) { console.log(x, y); }
n(undefined);
function u(x: unknown) { console.log(x); }
u();
function an(x: any) { console.log(x); }
an();
function gen<T>(x: T) { console.log(x); }
gen<void>();
gen<number | void>();
function ud(x: undefined) {} ud();
function un(x: string | undefined) {} un();
